# Billing fiscal-onboarding contract fixtures

These files are a versioned test snapshot of the Billing API v1 fiscal-onboarding contract. They were copied from `Kmena/Billing-API` commit `b76c63fceff9eb7a312a97f29b8ee8f09b2376e0` so this repository's CI does not depend on a sibling checkout.

Refresh the OpenAPI document and operation catalog together whenever Inventori adopts a newer Billing contract revision.
